mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is negative: lower FEDFUNDS predicts higher returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.1% fails to predict positive 20-day returns (negative returns in >60% of cases) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over the past month indicates weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profit growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises >0.5pp in 1 month, 5-day returns are positive in >60% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in the past month indicates a weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both decline >0.5% in 1 month, 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) from the prior month indicates a weakening supply chain and slowing economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, when INDPRO declines from prior month, 60-day returns are positive in >60% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust residential construction activity, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1400 fails to predict positive 20-day returns (negative returns in >60% of cases) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index level above 260 (indicating elevated inflation) signals potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 260, 5-day returns are positive in >60% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points in the past month indicates a labor market imbalance, increasing economic uncertainty and depressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases and UNRATE rises >0.2pp in 1 month, 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle recovery, a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 106.0 indicates accelerating economic growth, enhancing corporate profit outlook and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the early-cycle recovery regime, when INDPRO > 106.0, 60-day returns are negative in >60% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
